races.verdict: Horses with experience have been favoured in recent renewals of this race. FLAMBE FLEUR and Wo Wo Never fit that bill, and it's the sole filly in the race who gets the nod, with her debut form working out very well. Aidan O'Brien's Paraguay is the sole runner with a Group 1 entry and needs a close look along with Paythebelievers . Acknowledge may do best of the newcomers. FLAMBE FLEUR WO WO NEVER (IRE) PARAGUAY (USA)
